edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner before allowing transferOwnership to execute.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier that checks msg.sender == owner.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner and then zeroes newOwner.
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd computation.
safeAdd assigns its result to the local variable c.
safeAdd performs unchecked raw addition a + b that relies on a manual require for overflow safety.
Parameter a flows into the safeSub computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeSub computation.
safeSub assigns its result to the local variable c.
safeSub performs raw subtraction a - b relying on require(b <= a) to avoid underflow.
Parameter a flows into the safeMul computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeMul computation.
safeMul assigns its result to the local variable c.
safeMul performs raw multiplication a * b validated only by a manual require on the quotient.
Parameter a flows into the safeDiv computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeDiv computation.
safeDiv assigns its result to the local variable c.
safeDiv performs raw division a / b guarded only by require(b > 0).
tokenOwner parameter is used to index the balances mapping in balanceOf.
